nom: PEACH & LILY The Good Acids Pore Toner

avis.texte: I have been using Peach and Lily for about 2-3 years now... keep being told by associates that this line is not for mature skin. Well, so far so good for this almost 53 year old.

Even though I'm older, I noticed bumps on my forehead so I decided to try this toner. It immediately cleared up and is staying that way. Next time I'll order the toner to give my skin moisture and alternate with this one, so I won't dry out my skin too much.

I purchased this as a last hurrah a month or two before my wedding to improve my skin texture for smoother makeup application. My MUA noticed the difference and immediately commented on how smooth my skin looked during my wedding weekend and the only new addition to my skincare was this toner. So grateful to have purchased this and I highly recommend it!
So far I like the toner, but haven't seen many results yet. However I've got a lot going on impacting my skin, so we'll see how it helps over time.

This toner fixed my skin in a few days! It's amazing. I had small white bumps around my eyes that were not acne and this product removed them within a couple of days. I use it twice a day morning and night and all of the bumps are gone, and my face is smoother and cleaner. I love love love this product.
I use this after the exfoliate cream as it was recommended. I see it sink into my skin, but I just started to use it to see benefits. It is recommended to use every other day for women over 55.

I use this to help with my acne scars and to help clear my skin when it has a breakout. It's a bit harsher then some of the other toners on my dry skin but it is still worth it and can easily be managed with the right moisturizer.
Love this stuff! Feels nice and clean on my face and gets rid of any left over make up.
helps my acne so much!! the little blackheads that aren't really blackheads on my nose are almost entirely gone when i use it consistently!
Works so well keeping my skin acne free and it does not dry my skin out like a lot of things I have tried using to keep acne at bay.
love using this in my daily skincare routine. it leaves my face feeling fresher and cleansed without drying out my face.
I use it every AM & PM after washing on face, makes my skin feel cleaner and pores smaller, helps my skin look good even when not wearing makeup!!

It works nicely. I wish it was a different color or hidden in a container so it could look prettier in my routine line up. I found the resurfacing mask more helpful than this for pores but I use this in my daily routine for maintenance
Super gentle and reduced redness in my face and my skin tone has a more even look!
I started using this toner with the essence from Peach and Lily every night and it has significantly helped my skin texture!

avis.titre: helps clarify, very gentle on sensitive skin
avis.texte: This is a good product overall, its helped keep my oily pores looking less congested, it took a couple months of use to see improvement since it is very gentle. so dont expect overnight results! only con is the price point 🤷‍♀️ not sure if id buy again once im out.

This goes on very easily and no sensitivity noted so far. It says to only use twice a week to start and I haven't used it more than that yet, but so far it feels great and makes my skin feel like it got a deep clean without any sensitivity or irritation.

My skin is very sensitive so I started out using this product slowly not every day. It did not make my skin red, however my skin started to purge when used more frequently. So I use it x2 a week only. It gives a healthy glow and absorbs easily. It does not leave behind a sticky residue which is good. Very good exfoliant overall. I recommend it.

I'm in love with the glass skin line from PEACH & LILY! I've gone ahead and included this toner in my skin care line up; I use it once a day in the P.M. It gently exfoliates my face without irritation my skin! I'm very pleased with this product.
This product has become a must in my routine. It's great for those pesky little bumps that seem to love my chin so much and gentle enough to use multiple times a week.
I use this every night before hydrating. It has been a game changer for the overall texture and tone of my skin. All of my serums soak in better and my acne and scarring has improved significantly!
I use this every morning and night and it has helped with a more clean look. Also minimized my pores.
LOVE this toner!!! I have used for years and always makes my skin feel great!!!
I think this works! Since I started using it, my skin feels more even, with less minor bumps here and there.

Love this toner, it does I would say "shrink" the appearance of pores over time. It really exfoliates your skin without being harsh. I've nearly use the entire peach and Lilly and slices collection and my skin is very grateful
Other toners tend to smell like alcohol or bad in general. This gently exfoliates and feels nice on my sensitive skin. No breakouts. I like the glass packaging too.

avis.titre: Very light weight on my s
avis.texte: Very light weight on my skin and does my pores wonder! I always keep it in stock :hearts:️
I really like this! I use it every 2-3 days and I love the blue color!
I have very sensitive skin and this does not irritate it. It has helped to reduce my acne.

I really like this toner. It helps with my acne without being too astringent. It's very thin like water so it layers well under my other products. It feels refreshing and my pores look smaller and my blackheads are going away. This stuff is going to be a new staple for me.

I like the clean feel of this. I use all Peach & Lily skin products and was using the essence toner but I like this one better. Doesn't feel quite as drying but my skin seems to like this one better. Appearance looks better since.
This is suppose to be pore minimizing, but don't see it. Not astringent enough for my taste. I was using Clinque #2 . Will most likely go back.

I haven't found one thing of Peach & Lily that I didn't like! I'm always hesitant with new products but I have not had any issues. My skin is glowing and clear and I could not ask for much more. Being in my mid 40s I have become religious with my routine and I'm glad that I could add this to it.
This toner is extremely gentle, no burning sensation and no irritation at all after using it ! My skin absorbs it in a few seconds, and the next day it's so soft and glowy. Will repurchase !

This is the only BHA/AHA exfoliating toner I've found that gently exfoliates your skin in such a soft way to keep the skin looking and feeling softer and more radiant! This is one of my favorite toners especially since I have oily and acne-prone skin. So good. Make sure you're also using SPF everyday—especially with this product.

avis.titre: Peach & Lily The Good Acids Toner
avis.texte: I already use a lot of Peach & Lily skincare products and this has been another great one. I got this toner to help with the appearance of my pores and breakouts. This toner is a gentle exfoliator and I like that it has both glycolic and salicylic acid. It's gentle enough to use daily, but if you have sensitive skin like me, I recommend starting with only 1-2 days a week and working towards a more frequent use. I've been super happy with this brand and I love how all the packaging is glass!
I absolutely love the way this Maite's my skin feel as I struggle with a bit of texture issue. It also helps keep the oiliness away
This is hands down the best toner I've ever used. It doesn't irritate my sensitive, combo skin or strip it dry. Clears up any acne and my skin feels so fresh afterward! I highly recommend.

This gentle yet effective toner is the fix you need! I have a constant battle with acne and have to avoid picking or else I will get scars. This toner helps me keep clean and clear and leaves my skin looking healthy! Also, blue is my favorite color!

Ever since I switched to Peach & Lily, I have noticed a huge difference in my skin! This toner is a must as every time I use it, my face feels so fresh. It is also so gentle on my skin. Would highly recommended!

avis.titre: A staple in my skincare routine.
avis.texte: My son recently developed breakouts in his skin, so I put him on a simplified version of my regimen with a face wash and toner. The Good Acids Pore Toner has really been helpful for him as his skin starts to change and has done a good job at controlling the development of new blackheads and blemishes while taking care of his current ones. He was nervous when he read "Acids," but the toner is very gentle and works on both of our skin types. I'm very happy to be able to share the toner with my son and help build his skincare routine, and he's very happy so far with the results.
I was worried it would dry my skin out and it does. The toner works really well
I absolutely LOVE the Good Acids Toner! It soaks in immediately and leaves your skin feeling so fresh & clean!
This is my second bottle of The Good Acid Toner. I love this, I love all Peach & Lily product. The toner leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean.
Is lightweight but refreshes my skin. Already seeing and feeling results after a few weeks.
Cannot wait to run out of current product and replace all with peach and lily!
Loveee love lovee loveeee loveeee This feels so soothing on my skin and i really love that it's glasss like it preserves so well!!!
I love this product. It gives me the perfect amount with each use. My skin looks softer and more radiant.
Works well on my sensitive skin. My skin is on the dryer side with some uneven layers texture and this helps smooth it out. Doesn't leave my skin irritated or tight.
I've been using this product for a few weeks now and I think it has given my large pores a smoother appearance.
The toner makes my skin feel amazing And fresh. It is so lightweight And dries instantly

I have folliculitis and my skin is extremely volatile. Previously it was recommended to me to try a toner and I went with this one. I practically immediately saw a difference in my skin quality and this has become a "ride or die" product in my skincare routine.
Better than expected! I noticed my pores had shrunk after a week of application. It definitely goes well with Glass Skin serum.
absolutely love this toner! Game changer, and great for sensitive skin!

I haven't been using the product for a long time yet, but so far I've noticed a positive change in my skin. I use it with the glass skin refining serum and I think the combination of the two has helped my skin texture! Hopefully over time I notice more changes. So far so good! I think I would change the packaging a little bit because you really have to shake it to get the stuff out
This product is non drying and feels fresh on my face! I have super sensitive skin and it's never caused any problems
I just really like it, been using it for a year now and feel like it isn't too harsh on my skin which is nice :)
Easy to use and seems to work well with my skin. I enjoy their ingredients.

I have been using this for about 2 years. It gives my skin a nice glow but without harsh redness or irritation. I have large pores and it helps the appearance especially under makeup when used in the morning.

The Discovery kit was more than I expected. After two use uses of the kit I feel in love. My skin feel more balanced and healthy. It works really well with make make up. I have dark skin and over the last 2 weeks I can go with out full face make up. My skin is look almost like flawless with no make up. I can't wait to see a full month results
I love this toner. I feel like it makes such a huge difference to my skin care routine. The packaging is beautiful and simple. I'm on my second bottle.

This is my favorite Peach & Lily product. It really does what it claims. I've used other toners from other brands that don't work half as well and are extra drying. The Good Acids Pore Toner keeps my pores unclogged with zero irritation.
I bought for this for my pores, hoping it would reduce their appearance and I don't see any results
This is an effective toner. In the short time I've used it, my skin feels cleaner and looks more even. I'm super happy with this product. It will soon be a staple of mine.

This toner has worked better than any acne product I've used as an adult within this price range. Quick results and so gentle that I have started my tween daughter on it with excellent and swift results.
I love this product. It feels so cleansing and seems to even my skin tone and complexion.

This is my favorite skincare product that I've ever come across! At the beginning of my skincare journey I had very painful cystic reactive acne, and it was very hard for me to find a GENTLE but EFFECTIVE exfoliant that I could use daily. Even if I have an active breakout or a damaged skin barrier this toner has never and will never ever burn or make matters worse. I absolutely adore it and will be buying another soon.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again!
avis.texte: My face feels amazing after using it. Super clean and refreshed!
I love it! I have tried so many toners that were too harsh and this one doesn't dry my skin and reduced my pores in just a few days.
I use this product daily because it's such a gentle exfoliant. I never let it run out because I don't want to be without it.

I've tried various other toners over the years that have worked alright, but I always come back to this one! My skin feels clean and ready for the rest of my routine after using it, and there is a noticeable difference over time of my skin texture and the number of breakouts I have (big decrease!) I have a lot of super early mornings and long days on film sets with lots of make up and reapplications/touch ups, so this has been so helpful in keeping my skin healthy and glowing. Love it!

Leave my skin feeling clean and fresh. Is not harsh, no stinging, burning, drying. My face has been super smooth since I started using it. I've been able to cut down on the amount of manual exfoliation I used to do.

New to this product but not only does it work wonders for your face,it works on your hands as well!! Perfect for sensitive or dry skin because it doesn't dry your skin out. the gentlest exfoliating toner I've ever used

avis.titre: Nice product, not sure about it helpfulness
avis.texte: I purchased to use after my cleansing and before my vitamin C for dark spot treatment to prep my skin. I only use this toner a few times a week versus every clean. Not sure yet if my frequency is enough to help reduce the dark spots from pregnancy acne. Does not really moisturize or add hydration back to the skin.
Skin changes every few years, what i needed changed, it helped me with eczema …strong enough to do the work and delicate enough for sensitive skin.
This is a great product! Left my skin feeling cool, refreshed, clean and moisturized! Highly recommend adding as part of your skin care routine.

This toner is literally the best skin care product I've tried, in general, ever!! I had a bad breakout and applied this toner to the area 2-3 times a day for 3 days and my skin was then completely clear and evened out. I truly could not believe it, total game changer!! Definitely worth the money, still can't believe how well it works!!

avis.titre: Great oil control and texture toner
avis.texte: I use this everynight, i love that it is alcohol free. Really helps eith oil production

I love this toner! I use it every morning and every evening after my 2-step cleansing and before my essence, serums and moisturizer. And while using it two times a day 7 days a week for a month, i still have half of the bottle left to use!

I had been neglecting my skincare routine but I tend to be frugal so obviously I hate spending money on products that falsify promised results. Peach and Lily is worth every pennie. This product particularly make my pores feel refreshed. Especially when paired with the exfoliating shining scrub! I love this line!!
The best toner I've used! It is gentle on my skin but also leaves it feeling soft and hydrated.

Looks intimidating, but love this acid and it is super easy! No cotton pad waste which is great. Simply shake some product into your hand and pat on your face. No tingly feeling! Started out slow with frequency of use and built on that.
I love this toner, feels so good on skin. Keeps my skin fresh, scars are fading and acne are less and less. I LOVEEE IT

This review is not sponsored! Bought this with my own money and i finisbed my entire bottle! This is now a staple in my skin care routine. I hsve oily combo skin and 38 yrs old. This is gentlento use every morning and night. Doesnt strip my skin and gentle removes all the excess dirt, oil and skin i may have missed. Will definerly be repurchasing and seen visible reaults in my skin!
This toner is the absolute best! It's not harsh, exfoliates, and my skin is clearer and looks great!
This is the best toner I've ever used! It's not harsh, it exfoliates, and my skin looks clearer after using it for a week. I will recommend this to anyone and everyone.
This toner is perfect for my almost 50yr old skin! It's not drying and it feels like a drink of water for my skin pre serum!
I like this toner! I bought it years ago and used it then forgot so rebought again. Used it everyday and no irritation! I recommend

avis.titre: Good toner to add to rotation
avis.texte: I've used this only a couple times so far but my skin feels very smooth and clean afterwards.
I am definitely starting to see a difference in my pores. This has been one of my biggest issues! Love it
This toner has been so great! I get a lot of random breakouts, especially fungal acne. This has really helped clearing my skin without drying it out
The Holy Grail!! I wish I had taken a before picture. I have tried for years to get rid of my larger blocked pores and this did the trick!! I couldn't believe my eyes after just a few uses.
I started using toners just now and Im glad i chose this one. My skin felt brighter after the first use and i think it is safe enough to use daily.
This is a great toner! I feel like it's definitely benefiting my skin as far as pores, keeping it clear and not trying it out.
